notes.title: Kejora will now release on 8th January 2026!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="638tsmf1Jd4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]After working on the game for the past 4 years, we were excited to finally release our project into the world on 4th September 2025. However, after the announcement that [i]Hollow Knight: Silksong[/i] was to release on the same day, we made the tough decision to shift our release away from September. [/p][p]We want the best for our project, for it to be seen and supported, and this can not be done if it releases on the same day as [i]Silksong[/i]; with no disrespect. We, as well, have been eagerly anticipating this title, and it was just unfortunate it was set to release on the same day we chose months ago. [/p][p]While [i]Kejora[/i] was set for a Steam-only release on 4th September, we are now looking forward to bringing [i]Kejora[/i] to you on [b]8th January 2026[/b], together with the Epic Games Store, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4/5, and Xbox Series X|S platforms! [/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has supported and played [i]Kejora[/i] so far! We apologize for the delay, but we hope you'll stick around for the game in 2026![/p]

notes.title: Kejora has a release date!
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce that we have finally confirmed a release date for Kejora! Kejora will be available on Steam on [b]4th September 2025 [/b]

It's been a long journey, but we're happy to finally be in the last legs of development and production, and we couldn't have done it without the support and love from the community!

Thank you all, and we'll see you on 4th September!

notes.title: The Days of Ramadan Steam Festival!
notes.notes:
We are happy to be part of The Days of Ramadan Steam Festival, from now till the end of March.

We are leaving our Steam Next Fest demo up to be available throughout this event, so if you haven't had a chance to check it out during Steam Next Fest, you will have the whole month of March to check it out!

Leave a wishlist if you enjoyed the game, and if you have any feedback or suggestions, leave a comment or Community Hub post below 💚

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1410400/Kejora/

notes.title: Play our Steam Next Fest demo now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1410400/Kejora/

A new and updated demo for Kejora is live and ready, ahead of time for Steam Next Fest!

If you played the previous demo, this Steam Next Fest build includes more content, animation updates, some UI and UX updates, and fixed previously reported bugs. 

Try out the updated demo, and if you have any feedback or suggestions, we'd love to hear it! Just leave a comment below or in the community hub. And wishlist the game if you haven't already, it goes a long way! 🫶
